links.outcome: Expert-rated understandability and actionability of AI-generated epilepsy storybooks (PEMAT-A/V) and reliability (DISCERN)
links.effect: Mean DISCERN 71.03 ± 1.09; PEMAT-A/V understandability/applicability scores of 92.22 and 100, rated by five experts.
links.quote: Results showed high reliability (mean DISCERN score = 71.03 ± 1.09) and excellent understandability and applicability (PEMAT-A/V scores of 92.22 and 100).

unlisted_practices: Medical text-locking protocol to prevent AI-generated misinformation in high-risk content (medication guidance, seizure first aid)
Iterative prompt engineering with expert-led refinement for AI-generated patient education storybooks

screen.reason: Empirical study describing the development and expert evaluation (using DISCERN and PEMAT-A/V) of multimodal educational storybooks generated via human-AI collaboration (Gemini 2.5 Pro). Although safeguards like medical text-locking protocols and expert-in-the-loop oversight were used during creation, the study does not compare outcomes with vs. without these practices.
